name: How long does a full interior paint job usually take in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How long does a full interior paint job usually take in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a full interior paint job depends on several factors, including the size of your home, the complexity of the trim work, and the extent of surface preparation required. On average, a typical 1,500 to 2,500 square foot home can take anywhere from three to seven days. Larger homes or those with extensive repairs might take longer. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full interior paint job for an average home in the Bay Area typically takes 3 to 7 days, depending on size and complexity.
